raw_segments.text: But on this occasion he was in no mood for games.
He had very important business of his own before him, something almost mysterious.
Meanwhile time was passing and Agafia, with whom he could have left the children, would
He had several times already crossed the passage, opened the door of the lodger's room and
looked anxiously at the kids who were sitting over the book, as he had bidden them.
Every time he opened the door they grinned at him, hoping he would come in and would
But Agafia was bothered and did not go in.
